# Chart fixtures

The chart fixtures are of two kinds. Neither is a client's record.

The events are public sky events (two equinoxes, a solstice, a full moon, a
solar eclipse and a great conjunction), chosen so a reader can verify each with
Astrolog itself; the recorded outputs here come from a natal cast the day after
the 1985 vernal equinox at Greenwich, the Sun at 0 Aries 55.

The persons are public figures whose birth data is published: Johannes Kepler,
and Dane Rudhyar, Alice A. Bailey and Michel Gauquelin, whom the Astrolog 8.00
manual names. Each file names its source and the Rodden Rating there. A test
holds the list, and no other file may name a person.

Every file is written by Astrolog 8.00 itself, so its first line is `@AI800`.

A future fixture may be added only when this declaration remains true: never
copy, derive from, or verify against an end-user chart library, and never add a
client or a private person. No automatic check can determine a chart datum's
provenance; the change author and reviewer make that judgment.
